period_note: BASIS: CONSOLIDATED, not Solo. This source (the bank's own website newspaper-style quarterly disclosure, a genuinely different and richer source than the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials' BSEC table previously used for FY2019-2025, which is confirmed exhausted for FY2011-2018 -- no such table exists in any of those years' annual reports) presents ONLY a Consolidated Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Statement/Cash Flow Statement/Statement of Changes in Equity in every quarter checked FY2011-2018 -- no Solo section is printed in the main 3-panel layout. This is a REAL, PERVASIVE basis mismatch against this dataset's Solo Q4/annual series for all of FY2011-2018 (the whole block newly added this session), matching the same CONSOLIDATED pattern already documented for FY2022/2024/2025's interim quarters (as opposed to the SOLO FY2019-2021/2023 interim quarters) -- see sources.json and insights.json's reporting_basis/data_gaps fields for the full picture across all years. Cross-validated: this file's own figures satisfy Assets=Liabilities+Equity, NII=Interest Income-Interest Expense, Total Operating Income=NII+non-interest income, Profit before provision=TOI-TOE, Profit before taxation=PBP-Total provision, and Profit after taxation=PBT-Tax, all to the exact taka, and the equity components (paid-up capital+statutory reserve+other reserve+retained earnings+minority/non-controlling interest) sum exactly to Total Shareholders' Equity. Not linked from the current thepremierbankplc.com/financial-reports/ page (which has no H1/Q2 entry for any year before 2016); recovered via Wayback Machine (capture 2020-05-07) of an older premierbankltd.com upload path. LARGE SPECIFIC PROVISION FOUND: Specific Provision of 1,747,424,719 (cumulative Jan-Jun 2013) drove a large reported net loss (Profit after taxation -1,997,793,950, EPS -3.90) -- this is a genuine reported figure, not a transcription error (independently confirmed via the Statement of Changes in Equity's own 'Net profit for the year' row of -1,997,794,393, a Tk 443 minority-interest rounding difference from the P&L's -1,997,793,950, both internally consistent). This loss partially reversed by Q3 2013 (discrete Jul-Sep 2013 profit of 866,626,365 per 2013_Q3.json's own P&L column), consistent with a specific-provision event taken in H1 that did not recur in Q3.
